The drivers were API demand for recent models, including GPT-6 Astra, quietly strong image-model demand, and ads running at a $1 billion annualized pace. Operating losses grew to an estimated $10.1–10.9 billion, though operating margin improved from −150% to −109%.

items.summary: Business: The startup, founded less than a year ago by Sonder founder Francis Davidson, booked $60 million in travel across tens of thousands of users last summer. Davidson says he threw out the old playbook for a lean, AI-first process, including dictating about 1.2 million words a month. The service has shut down, and OpenAI is quiet about its travel plans.
